title: Perplexity citations get their sources
summary:
Perplexity citations gained source URLs, while the news highlights and README caught up with recent model and image updates.

Plain-text `/text` responses now append a numbered Sources list when citations are returned, giving Perplexity citation markers URLs to match. The `perplexity-reasoning` alias now routes to `sonar-reasoning-pro`, and unrecognized model response formats return an error instead of fallback text.

The news highlights list gained entries covering Gemini tools, `Qwen3-Coder-30B`, standalone `flux`, and SPAN 2x image upscaling. This updated the news list, not the underlying models or APIs.

The README’s Latest News list now covers the same four topics and drops older entries to keep the list at ten. No underlying features changed in this PR.
